- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested considerations for choosing a car cover include material, fit, thickness, ease of use, and price.

- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for a car cover that is waterproof and breathable and is budget-conscious.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The OxGord Executive Car Cover is made of a 2-layer material that is waterproof and breathable.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The outer layer of the OxGord Executive Car Cover is waterproof polypropylene, and the inner layer is breathable mesh.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The OxGord Executive Car Cover is a universal-fit cover, which may not fit as precisely as a custom-fit cover.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The price of the OxGord Executive Car Cover is usually around $30-$40.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of the OxGord Executive Car Cover include waterproof and breathable material, affordability, ease of installation, and a compact storage bag.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cons of the OxGord Executive Car Cover include a universal fit that might not be precise, potential durability issues, and reported problems with straps or elastic hems.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Final verdict on the OxGord Executive Car Cover is that it is a good choice for budget-conscious users looking for basic protection.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Regular gas is suitable for most passenger vehicles and is the least expensive.
